title: Engineering Manager, Consumer

organization.name: Zapp
organization.description: Series B B2C quick-commerce company with £100M+ annual revenue and $300M+ raised

bullets: Shipped post-checkout Additional Items feature, driving +23% revenue on amended orders.
Engineered an 8-skill AI coding suite carrying a ticket to a reviewed PR with screenshot and video evidence, adopted org-wide.
Built a ticket-to-PR AI harness with custom linters, architecture checks and three AI reviewers enforcing shared standards.
Initiated the transition to product engineering, defining expectations, levelling and pay bands across four roles.
Consolidated 6 apps and 15 packages in a Turborepo monorepo, standardising tooling and CI.
Replaced 3-day QA freezes with 125 Maestro flows and 7,600+ unit tests, enabling weekly iOS and Android releases.

bullets.text: Accelerated iOS and Android release cadence from monthly to weekly, shipping 10+ versions.
Scaled mobile QA to 125 Maestro test flows and 7,600+ unit tests, with automated smoke and nightly iOS/Android runs.

bullets: Led the biggest SEV1 in company history, then built the company-wide incident function, severity framework, and SOP.
